notes: README image assets under media/readme_images and media/svg are public-facing and included.
Sound reference/log files under modules/audio_volumes/sounds are public-facing and included.
Internal docs live under internal_dev and are excluded.
All include/exclude paths are relative to the inner LsTweeks addon directory, not the repository root.
The package must contain one top-level folder matching the addon-root .toc filename.
